nodes.name: auth_sessions.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the generalized auth_sessions table supporting all dashboard roles (rest_admin, rider, sys_admin) with magic-link token lifecycle, cookie binding, and revocation tracking. Replaces the older dashboard_sessions table.

nodes.name: auth_sessions
nodes.summary: Generalized session table storing magic-link tokens, cookie hashes, role discriminators, and revocation state for all dashboard user types.

nodes.name: dashboard_sessions.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the legacy dashboard_sessions table for restaurant admin magic-link authentication. Superseded by auth_sessions.sql but retained for migration compatibility.

nodes.name: dashboard_sessions
nodes.summary: Legacy restaurant-admin-only session table with magic-link token, cookie binding, and revocation fields, scoped to a single rest_ref.

nodes.name: db_config.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the app_config key-value table and seeds the dispatch_batch_limit config value. Also contains an example stub of the job_create_dispatch stored procedure showing config-driven batch limiting.

nodes.name: app_config
nodes.summary: Simple key-value configuration table for database-level runtime parameters such as dispatch_batch_limit.

nodes.name: debug_log.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the debug_log table used by PostgreSQL trigger functions to write structured diagnostic messages including trigger name, order number, and optional JSONB payload.

nodes.name: debug_log
nodes.summary: Diagnostic log table written to by PostgreSQL trigger functions; each row records the trigger name, order number, free-text message, and an optional JSONB payload.

nodes.name: delivery_models.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the delivery_pricing_detail table recording per-order pricing breakdown including byteloop platform cost, restaurant cost, driver payout, and distance.

nodes.name: delivery_pricing_detail
nodes.summary: Stores the computed pricing breakdown for each delivery order: byteloop platform margin, restaurant charge, and driver payout amounts.

nodes.name: delivery_option.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the delivery_option table holding vehicle-type-specific pricing options presented to customers during order creation, including commission, payout, and total charge breakdowns.

nodes.name: delivery_option
nodes.summary: Records available delivery options per order with vehicle-type-specific pricing tiers, commission percentages, and total charge breakdown fields.

nodes.name: detail.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the delivery_detail table that holds the active delivery assignment record per order, linking order_number to the assigned vehicle type, rider, dispatch, and status.

nodes.name: delivery_detail
nodes.summary: Central tracking record per delivery order capturing the current status, assigned rider, vehicle type, distance, and linked dispatch_id.

nodes.name: dispatch.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the delivery_dispatch table tracking individual rider assignment attempts per order, along with the delivery_dispatch_whook_statement() trigger function that fires a statement-level webhook to /delivery-hooks/delivery-dispatch on each batch INSERT.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a statement-level trigger with REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows to batch all INSERTs in one webhook POST, avoiding N+1 HTTP calls.

nodes.name: delivery_dispatch
nodes.summary: Records every rider dispatch attempt for an order with status lifecycle (unassigned → accepted/declined/missed → assigned → completed) and payout tracking columns for the rider dashboard.

nodes.name: dispatch_bulk.sql
nodes.summary: Defines an alternate statement-level trigger (trigger_delivery_dispatch_whook_bulk) and its handler function for batch dispatch webhooks, posting enriched bulk payloads to /delivery-hooks/delivery-dispatch-bulk.
nodes.languageNotes: Posts to a hardcoded bulk endpoint URL; likely a predecessor to dispatch.sql's configurable endpoint.

nodes.name: elas_stats.sql
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc analytics queries for the ELA restaurant reporting monthly delivery counts, takeaway order counts, and delivery values — includes embedded result data from past runs.

nodes.name: inflight.sql
nodes.summary: Defines delivery_inflight (active rider assignment table), the delivery_inflight_whook() row-level trigger that POSTs to /delivery-hooks/delivery-inflight-graph-init to start the LangGraph rider agent, and the notify_missed_dispatches() helper that notifies riders of missed opportunities.
nodes.languageNotes: Step 5 of the 6-step delivery workflow; trigger fires per INSERT row and chains two side-effects: graph init HTTP POST + missed-dispatch notification.

nodes.name: delivery_inflight
nodes.summary: Represents an active (inflight) delivery assignment linking dispatch_id, order, rider, and customer once a rider has accepted — its INSERT triggers the LangGraph rider agent initialization.

nodes.name: location.sql
nodes.summary: Defines rider_location (raw GPS telemetry) and rider_location_event (geofence transition events) tables, with a row-level trigger that POSTs to /location-hooks/notify-rider-location-event on each event INSERT.

nodes.name: rider_location
nodes.summary: Stores raw GPS telemetry from OwnTracks/rider devices including lat/lon, battery, accuracy, and region membership arrays per rider per order.

nodes.name: rider_location_event
nodes.summary: Records discrete geofence enter/leave events for riders linked to a specific order, triggering webhook notifications for live tracking updates.

nodes.name: masterdata.sql
nodes.summary: Defines core entity master tables: rider_master (rider profiles and shift state), restaurant_master (restaurant configuration including coordinates and admin contacts), customer_master (customer address book), and cust_rest_map (customer-restaurant consent mapping).

nodes.name: rider_master
nodes.summary: Master record for each rider including vehicle type, town, active shift status, dispatch priority, and shift response timestamps.

nodes.name: restaurant_master
nodes.summary: Master record for each restaurant including geolocation coordinates, admin WhatsApp numbers, address, and operating hours used throughout dispatch and confirmation flows.

nodes.name: customer_master
nodes.summary: Master record for each customer holding name, email, and delivery address coordinates used to calculate distance and populate delivery payloads.

nodes.name: cust_rest_map
nodes.summary: Many-to-many consent mapping between customers and restaurants, recording whether a customer has consented to receive marketing from a given restaurant.

nodes.name: ordelo_config.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the ordelo_config key-value table used at runtime by PostgreSQL trigger functions to look up the ORDELO_APP_URL webhook base and feature flags like ENABLE_TRIGGER_DEBUG_LOG.

nodes.name: ordelo_config
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration table keyed by config_key (e.g. ORDELO_APP_URL, ENABLE_TRIGGER_DEBUG_LOG) with description and auto-updated timestamp columns.

nodes.name: sbase_queues_from_order.sql
nodes.summary: Deprecated SQL script using pgmq queues (rider_accept_q) to process rider acceptance messages; superseded by direct trigger-based webhook flow and retained for reference.

nodes.name: summary.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the central delivery_summary table (delivery lifecycle status machine + restaurant confirmation status) with two webhook triggers: trigger_restaurant_updates fires restaurant_updates_whook() to POST to /delivery-hooks/restaurant-confirmation-request, and trigger_delivery_summary_timedout fires delivery_summary_timedout_whook() to POST to /delivery-hooks/delivery-timedout.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains two complete PL/pgSQL trigger functions with full payload construction, joining restaurant_master, food_order, and order_item tables before POSTing to the FastAPI webhook layer.

nodes.name: delivery_summary
nodes.summary: Central delivery order record combining the restaurant confirmation status machine, delivery lifecycle status, confirmation codes for restaurant and customer, pickup time, and WhatsApp message IDs for all three parties.

nodes.name: takeaway_summary.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the takeaway_summary table with a parallel restaurant-confirmation status machine for dine-in/takeaway orders, and two webhook triggers: trigger_takeaway_restaurant_updates (POSTs to /takeaway-hooks/restaurant-confirmation-request) and trigger_takeaway_pickup_time_set.
nodes.languageNotes: Parallel structure to summary.sql but for the takeaway flow; omits rider dispatch columns while retaining the same restaurant-confirmation status machine.

nodes.name: takeaway_summary
nodes.summary: Central takeaway order record tracking restaurant confirmation status, pickup time, admin contact, and WhatsApp message IDs without any rider dispatch columns.

nodes.name: waba_es.sql
nodes.summary: Defines the waba_es table that records WhatsApp Business Account embedded-signup and Facebook auth events, storing phone numbers, business IDs, and sensitive business tokens.

nodes.name: waba_es
nodes.summary: Audit log for WABA embedded-signup OAuth events capturing phone number IDs, business IDs, event types, and temporary auth codes.
